value.name: roc_momentum
value.rationale: Medium‑term price momentum tends to persist because market participants chase recent performance and trend‑following capital reinforces the move. By measuring the rate‑of‑change over a 20‑bar window and entering only when the change exceeds a modest 2 % threshold, the strategy captures sustained directional moves while staying flat during choppy periods, avoiding the high turnover that erodes returns after transaction costs.
